description: A closed catalogue of twelve film structures (helicopter view, one scene first, the case, the portrait, the timeline, the verdict, open question, the numbers, the correction, the object, the hindsight, the choice), each with a length window and an ending contract, plus the approach-suggest pass that ranks them against a source.
